_doc: Tham so hieu ung Soft Light. Sua truc tiep file nay roi chup thu, khong can build lai. Chay `npm run preview -- <anh.jpg>` de xem truoc ma khong ghi de.

softFocus._doc: Lam mo NHE ban kinh nho tren TOAN anh - lam min da va soi toc nhung cung lam mem ca phong nen. De 0 de giu phong nen (cham bi, chu, hoa van) sac net nhu ban tham chieu.

clarity._doc: Giam do net / do tuong phan cuc bo tren TOAN anh. De 0 vi cung ly do voi softFocus.

bloom._doc: TANG CHINH. Tach rieng vung tong da, lam mo that manh, tang sang roi screen len anh GOC con nguyen net. Vi mat na cat theo MAU DA chu khong theo do sang, phong nen khong bi loe. amount = do manh (0..1), radiusPct tinh theo chieu ngang anh, highlightCutoff loai vung sang hon muc nay (cham bi trang, den).

tone._doc: contrast am = giam tuong phan tong the. lift = nang vung den (0..0.2), tao cam giac bac mau ethereal. Ban tham chieu khong dung tang nay.

warm._doc: temp duong = am hon (tang do, giam lam). highlightWarmth phu them mau am len vung sang bang blend soft-light. Ban tham chieu khong dung tang nay.

output._doc: Chat luong JPEG ghi de. 4:4:4 giu mau vien toc/moi sac net hon 4:2:0.

backup._doc: Anh goc duoc chep vao thu muc con nay truoc khi ghi de. Su ton tai cua ban backup CHINH LA dau hieu 'da xu ly' - nho vay trigger co ban hai lan cung khong xu ly chong.

skip._doc: Bo qua nhung file co duong dan chua mot trong cac chuoi nay. Dung khi dslrBooth goi ca tren file template da ghep - lam mem ca to in se nhoe luon khung va logo. Vi du: ["\\prints\\", "_final"]

limits._doc: Bo qua anh nho hon minEdge px (thumbnail cua dslrBooth). maxMs chi de canh bao trong log khi xu ly qua cham so voi nhip chup.
